aggregation: Median of all three samples in each successful reset-app-data run, including the first sample; reduction = 100 * (1 - after / before). No profiler timings included in the comparison.
limitations: Debug -O iPhone simulator measurements on a shared Mac; no device or Release measurements.
Rendering replay measures application user + system CPU time, excluding separate WebKit/rendering processes and networking/Pi/tool execution.
UI CPU metrics measure the application during scripted gestures; clock time includes automation waits.
Small samples and overlapping ranges; no statistical significance claim for small differences.
All screens, iPad, accessibility sizes, voice input, real API streaming, energy use, and end-to-end performance are not fully verified.
